name: On Board Diagnostics 1
definition: Data captured from on board diagnostic systems

EngineIdleTime.name: Engine Idle Time
EngineIdleTime.definition: Current amount of time the vehicle engine has run idle (under no load) as determined by the vehicle monitoring system. ||Expressed in hours

EngineTotalIdleTime.name: Engine Total Idle Time
EngineTotalIdleTime.definition: Total amount of time the vehicle engine has run idle (under no load) since the last reset, as determined by the vehicle monitoring system.||Expressed in hours

EngineHours.name: Engine Hours
EngineHours.definition: Number of hours the engine has been running (including idle time) as determined by the vehicle monitoring system.

EngineTotalTime.name: Engine Total Time
EngineTotalTime.definition: Amount of time elapsed since the previous reset as determined by the vehicle monitoring system.||Expressed in hours

EngineLoad.name: Engine Load
EngineLoad.definition: Engine load measured as determined by the vehicle monitoring system.

EngineRPM.name: Engine RPM
EngineRPM.definition: Maximum revolutions per minute experienced by the crankshaft of the vehicle engine as determined by the vehicle monitoring system.

EngineOilTemperature.name: Engine Oil Temperature
EngineOilTemperature.definition: Temperature of the engine oil as determined by the vehicle monitoring system.

EngineOilPressure.name: Engine Oil Pressure
EngineOilPressure.definition: Pressure of the engine oil as determined by the vehicle monitoring system.

EngineOilLifeRemaining.name: Engine Oil Life Remaining
EngineOilLifeRemaining.definition: Time remaining before next oil change expressed as a percentage, as determined by the vehicle monitoring system.

CheckEngineWarningStatus.name: Check Engine Warning Status
CheckEngineWarningStatus.definition: Check engine status as determined by the vehicle monitoring system.

FuelTankLevelStart.name: Fuel Tank Level Start
FuelTankLevelStart.definition: Fuel tank start level reading as determined by the vehicle monitoring system.

FuelGaugeLevel.name: Fuel Gauge Level
FuelGaugeLevel.definition: Current fuel tank gauge level reading as determined by the vehicle monitoring system.

FuelEconomy.name: Fuel Economy
FuelEconomy.definition: Fuel economy expressed in terms of the amount of fuel consumed per unit of travel as determined by the vehicle monitoring system.

RefrigerationHours.name: Refrigeration Hours
RefrigerationHours.definition: Number of hours the refrigeration unit has been in operation.

RefrigerationTemperature.name: Refrigeration Temperature
RefrigerationTemperature.definition: Temperature of the refrigeration unit/trailer as determined by the vehicle monitoring system.

CoolantTemperature.name: Coolant Temperature
CoolantTemperature.definition: Temperature of the coolant as determined by the vehicle monitoring system.

BatteryVoltage.name: Battery Voltage
BatteryVoltage.definition: Voltage of the vehicle battery as determined by the vehicle monitoring system.

HardBraking.name: Hard Braking
HardBraking.definition: Number of occurrences of hard breaking as determined by the vehicle monitoring system.

HardAcceleration.name: Hard Acceleration
HardAcceleration.definition: Number of occurrences of hard acceleration as determined by the vehicle monitoring system.
